localChanges: chore: update core-game, core-save-game, core-score and civ1-score

log: `Score` rules for v474.05's terms: citizens counted at 40% luxuries, 20 a Wonder, a landed spaceship, −10 a polluted square, 3 a turn of world peace (AD only, at most 100) and 5 a Future Technology. A `Start` rule counts a turn of world peace in the years AD and a `Defeated` rule ends it (civ-clone/web-renderer#149).
From the new core-score: the turns the world has gone without a fight, which the Civilization Score counts (civ-clone/web-renderer#149).
`worldPeace` is runtime state (one `WorldPeace`). A file written before this has no `worldPeace` membership and loads with no turns of peace (civ-clone/web-renderer#149).

`Score` rules give the terms of a player's score as `{ term, value }`; `scoreTerms` lists them and `score` adds them up, never below 0. `WorldPeace` counts the turns the world has gone without a fight, held by a one-entry `WorldPeaceRegistry` so that it's saved (civ-clone/web-renderer#149).
